title: ר' יוסי בן נהוראי

paragraphs: Rabbi Yose ben Nehorai was Rabbi Yochanan’s teacher: Rashi, HaMafkid 41b, beginning; at the end of page a, ‘Rabbi Yochanan said: Rabbi Yose ben Nehorai said.’ Tosafot write that although Rabbi Yose ben Nehorai was a tanna, Rabbi Yochanan disagrees with him, and so forth. But that is not so: the Jerusalem Talmud says Rabbi Yose ben Nehorai heard what Rabbi Lazar said. Rabbi Acha transmitted in his name: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 3, mishnah 3; Lulav HaGazul, halakhah 11; end of Rosh Hashanah, chapter 1 [parallel at 3:10:2]. Rabbi Berekhiah and his father Rabbi Chiyya transmitted in his name; see his entry. Rabbi Yehudah be-Rabbi Simon transmitted in his name: Vayikra Rabbah, section 27, and Midrash Kohelet, on ‘That which has been already is.’ He asked Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi: Ellu Terefot 57b. He and Rabbi Yochanan ben Arza were sitting.
